name: hotreload-debug-3
description: Root cause: carried blocked sendQ dribbles out app-paced through the 2KB CLIENT_TCP_WINDOW send buffer; against a slow reader the tail+PONG wedge in a TCP zero-window persist that doesn't recover before ping timeout -> silent. Fix: grow SO_SNDBUF to hold the whole backlog on adoption (os_set_sockbufs in hotreload_load.c), kernel owns delivery like a server link; kqueue-safe. Debugger was cut off pre-verification; fix committed by orchestrator (8830e53), merged bf84d45. Empirical 10x verification dispatched (verify-sendq-fix). Also flagged: test_tls_keyupdate_after_reload_closes_cleanly needs characterization (flaky vs kernel-6.14 env).
